data.name: Sharujan
data.gender_notes: Sharujan is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sharujan is a combination of two Sanskrit words, 'Sharu' meaning 'Goddess of Prosperity' and 'Jana' meaning 'People'. This name signifies the Goddess who brings prosperity and happiness to the masses. The name Sharujan carries the meaning “Goddess of Prosperity and Happiness” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sharujan usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of prosperity and happiness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharujan is a divine name associated with the Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity, Lakshmi. It is believed that invoking this name brings abundance and prosperity in all forms, including material wealth, good health, and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Sharujan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Prosperity and Happiness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharujan total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
